verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible left-to-right order: can, then headline and copy, then badges and CTA. However, the circle nearly touches the top and left edges, GLACIER floats loosely, the body copy sits close to the bottom edge, and the right badge/CTA block is not aligned with the headline. B breaks the reading order: the badges and CTA sit in the middle column ahead of the headline, which is pushed to the far right. The tiny body copy is jammed against the bottom right, and GLACIER drifts with no clear relation to anything.
